title: Higher-Dimensional Thermodynamic Limits
exact_target: Control infinite-volume limits of the report's noncompact sigma models in more than one spatial dimension.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000466 (OWR-1266-005). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
The Rigorous Renormalization Group (2006), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2006/17, pp. 1027--1076; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 42--43, printed pages 1068--1069.

status_qualification: The report notes boundary-condition dependence even for invariant observables. Existence, normalization, convergence, and dependence are different aspects of rigorous control; the question does not assert a unique boundary-independent limit.
